title: A large wave crashes into the rocks at the end of a pier
place: Rock jetty / breakwater end (location not given on page)
notes: Handheld shot from atop a boulder jetty; rocks fill the left, foaming sea right, a navigation pole at the jetty tip (top, x~0.3-0.5). 0-2.5 s: white water surges along the rocks (x~0.35-0.6). 2.5-5.5 s: a wave slams the jetty and a tall spray column shoots up (x~0.4-0.55, y~0.15-0.7), falling over the rocks by 6 s. 6-14 s: camera pans/steps right showing the whole jetty being overwashed, water pouring off the rocks (x~0.2-0.7, y~0.4-0.6). No people, text or logos. Shot A 0.4-3.0 s, Shot B 3.0-5.7 s.
fact_en: Page description: "Dramatic slow-motion capture of waves crashing on rocks by the ocean shore."
